product_one_liner.value: Mimica records and analyzes how employees work, maps enterprise processes, and identifies opportunities for process improvement and automation.
product_one_liner.notes: Mimica says it is especially useful to large enterprises with complex departmental processes; its homepage describes capturing work, mapping end-to-end processes, and deploying agents to automate them.

pricing_page.notes: The public Mimica pricing listing presents the Mimica Platform and says to contact the vendor for pricing. A public pricing page qualifies even though no amounts are listed.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Mimica’s company article explicitly names DHL, Liberty Mutual, Merck, and Goodyear as Fortune 100 enterprise customers. | named_customers.0: Mimica’s article names DHL among its Fortune 100 enterprise customers. | named_customers.1: Mimica’s article names Liberty Mutual among its Fortune 100 enterprise customers. | named_customers.2: Mimica’s article names Merck among its Fortune 100 enterprise customers. | named_customers.3: Mimica’s article names Goodyear among its Fortune 100 enterprise customers.

employee_band.notes: The Mimica LinkedIn profile gives its company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Mimica’s LinkedIn company profile gives its headquarters as London, England. | hq_country: Mimica’s LinkedIn company profile identifies its headquarters as London, England, which is in the United Kingdom.

founded_year.notes: Mimica’s About Us journey identifies 2018 as the year the company was founded.

eng_blog.notes: The Articles index is organized around topical and company-news content and includes product/partner announcements; it does not present an engineering or technical blog with posts about how the product is built. Under the requested rule this is false.

public_docs.notes: The available homepage/help-related evidence exposes a Frequently Asked Questions section but does not identify a public product documentation site, developer portal, or multi-article help center; the observed material does not meet the requested threshold for public docs.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open Mimica jobs board includes a Senior/Lead Machine Learning Engineer posting, and its job description describes ownership of ML pipelines; this satisfies the specified role criteria.

model_provider.notes: Mimica’s live engineering role describes building agents with Claude (Anthropic), Gemini (Google), and GPT (OpenAI), and discusses building and deploying those agents. The job posting is the public statement supporting the named providers.

compliance_certs.notes: Mimica’s homepage expressly says it is compliant with ISO 27001 and GDPR, and its trust center names ISO 27001:2022. Those are the listed qualifying compliance claims.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Mimica’s announcement explicitly identifies the $26.2 million round as Series B. | funding_date: The company announcement dates its Series B funding announcement to September 24, 2025; the requested YYYY-MM value is 2025-09. | funding_amount_usd: Mimica’s dated announcement reports a $26.2 million Series B round, the latest company funding round located in the sources reviewed.

raised_18mo.notes: The $26.2 million Series B was announced September 24, 2025, which falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Mimica job listing is for an Associate Business Development Representative, a qualifying business-development-representative role.

launched_6mo.notes: Mimica published “Introducing Maker” on September 30, 2026, within the six months preceding November 9, 2026; it announced a new agentic automation product, so the launch condition is met.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Mimica’s readable job posting refers generically to connecting ERPs, CRMs, ticketing tools, and legacy apps but names no CRM or sales/marketing system. No specific system can be listed from this evidence.
